description: This file contains GUI dialog classes for editing events within the BORIS behavioral observation software, including dialogs for editing individual events and multiple selected events, with UI setup, event handling, and validation logic.

classes.name: DlgEditEvent
classes.description: Dialog class for editing a single event, handling UI setup, time and image index adjustments, and validation.

classes.name: EditSelectedEvents
classes.description: Dialog class for editing multiple selected events, allowing field selection and value editing.

methods.name: close_widget
methods.description: Validates and closes the dialog, ensuring image index is not null.

methods.name: set_to_current_image_index
methods.description: Sets the image index to the current image index.

methods.name: set_to_current_time
methods.description: Sets the time to the current media or exif date/time.

methods.name: time_na
methods.description: Toggles the time widget visibility and enabled state based on 'NA' checkbox.

methods.name: rb_changed
methods.description: Handles radio button toggling for editing fields.

methods.name: pbOK_clicked
methods.description: Validates selection and accepts the dialog.
